svg.title: From PyTorch code to AWS Trainium hardware
svg.desc: PyTorch describes the model. TorchNeuron is the backend connecting PyTorch to AWS Neuron software and a chosen Trainium generation. An illustrative isometric server board shows Trainium2 and Trainium3 as alternatives, not a mixed server. Training updates model weights; inference uses trained weights to produce predictions. Layout is conceptual, not a chip floorplan.
svg.text: One software framework. A different place to run the maths.
Define the model and its tensor operations.
PyTorch backend for the neuron device.
Uses the AWS Neuron software stack to run operations.
Choose a supported generation on AWS.

g.text: Alternative generations • illustrative layout, not a chip floorplan
